name: io.github.tresor4k/macalc-mcp
title: MaCalculatriceEnLigne
description: Calculs fiscaux et sociaux français datés : impôt sur le revenu 2026, SMIC, ARE, succession, TVA.

tools.name: calculate_french_income_tax
tools.description: Calculate French income tax (IR) 2026 on 2025 income per Article 197 CGI: progressive brackets with family quotient, family-quotient cap (1,807 EUR per extra half-share beyond 1 share single / 2 shares couple, 903.50 EUR per quarter share) and décote (897 EUR single / 1,483 EUR couple minus 45.25% of tax). Not implemented: the 4,262 EUR cap for single parents (parent isolé) and the special 1,079 / 1,801 EUR cases of art. 197 I-2; DOM reductions. Returns: {income, family_quotient, tax_before_cap, qf_cap, tax_after_cap, decote, total_tax, effective_rate_pct, marginal_rate_pct, brackets}.

income.description: Annual net taxable income in euros

parts.description: Number of fiscal shares (1=single, 2=married, +0.5 per child)

couple.description: true = joint taxation (married/PACS couple, base 2 shares); false = individual taxation (base 1 share)

tools.name: calculate_french_vat
tools.description: Calculate French VAT (TVA) — convert between HT (before tax) and TTC (after tax). Supports all 4 French VAT rates. Returns: {amount_ht, amount_ttc, vat_amount, vat_rate}.

mode.description: Input mode: ht=before tax, ttc=after tax

tools.name: calculate_compound_interest
tools.description: Compute compound interest growth A=P(1+r/n)^(nt). Use for savings, retirement projections, investment forecasting. Returns final amount, total interest, and yearly breakdown.

tools.name: calculate_loan_payment
tools.description: Calculate monthly loan payment for any generic loan. Returns: {principal, monthly_payment, total_cost, total_interest}.

tools.name: calculate_percentage
tools.description: Calculate percentages: value of total, percentage change, what percent.

operation.description: of: X% of Y; change: from A to B; what_pct: X is what % of Y

tools.name: calculate_area
tools.description: Compute area for common 2D shapes (rectangle, triangle, circle, trapezoid, etc.). Use for geometry, real estate, or paint estimates. Inputs: shape + dimensions. Returns area in input-units squared.

tools.name: calculate_life_path_numerology
tools.description: Calculate numerology life path number from birth date. Returns: {life_path_number, meaning}.

tools.name: calculate_quebec_income_tax
tools.description: Calculate Quebec provincial income tax (Revenu Québec) with the basic personal amount credited at the lowest rate. Excludes employment-specific credits (QPP/QPIP/EI, worker deduction): for a salary use calculate_canada_combined_tax. Returns: {income_cad, basic_personal_amount, basic_personal_credit, taxable_income, provincial_tax, effective_rate_pct, marginal_rate_pct, ...}.

tools.name: calculate_canada_rrq
tools.description: Calculate Quebec Pension Plan (RRQ) contributions for employee. Returns: {gross_annual_cad, rrq_base_earnings, rrq_contribution_tier1, rrq_additional_earnings, rrq_contribution_tier2, total_rrq_contribution, ...}.

tools.name: calculate_inheritance_tax
tools.description: Calculate French inheritance tax (droits de succession) based on relationship and amount. Returns: {amount, abatement, taxable_base, tax_due, effective_rate_pct, marginal_rate_pct}.

relationship.description: Relationship to deceased: spouse, child, grandchild (parent alive, 1 594 € allowance), sibling, nephew_niece (7 967 €, 55 %), relative_up_to_4th_degree (55 %), other (beyond 4th degree or unrelated, 60 %)

tools.name: calculate_severance_pay
tools.description: Calculate French severance pay for rupture conventionnelle or licenciement. Returns: {monthly_salary, years_first_10, years_above_10, gross_indemnite, note}.

monthly_salary.description: Reference gross monthly salary in euros

years_seniority.description: Years of seniority in the company

tools.name: calculate_unemployment_benefit
tools.description: Estimate French unemployment benefit (ARE — Aide au Retour a l'Emploi). Returns: {daily_ref_salary, daily_are, monthly_are_estimate, min_daily, max_daily_75pct_sjr}.

daily_ref_salary.description: Salaire journalier de référence (SJR) in euros

tools.name: calculate_belgian_salary
tools.description: Convert Belgian gross monthly salary to net salary (estimate: employee ONSS 13.07% + annual personal income tax, single, no municipal surcharge; same engine as /api/v1/salaire-net?pays=be). Returns: {gross_monthly, social_cotisations_13_07pct, special_social_contribution, professional_withholding_tax, net_monthly, net_annual, ...}.

tools.name: calculate_puissance_fiscale
tools.description: French fiscal horsepower (puissance administrative, Code des impositions sur les biens et services, CIBS art. L. 421-14 to L. 421-22). Default regime (cars M1 first registered in France from 2021-01-01, parameters in CIBS art. A. 421-3 to D. 421-11): PA = 1.80 x (PM/100)^2 + 3.87 x (PM/100) + 1.34 with PM = max net engine power in kW. Legacy regime (CIBS art. L. 421-15: cars first registered in France between 1998-07-01 and 2021-01-01, except types approved or modified from 2019-11-01, keep the formula of the former legislation, now in CIBS art. A. 421-12 to A. 421-23): PA = CO2/45 + (PM/40)^1.6. Result rounded to the nearest unit, 0.5 counted as 1. Returns: {regime, cv_raw, cv_fiscaux}.

power_kw.description: Max net engine power in kW (PM, field P.2 of the registration certificate)

regime.description: cibs_from_2021 = general case (cars first registered in France from 1 January 2021); cibs_l421_15_1998_2020 = cars first registered in France between 1 July 1998 and 1 January 2021 whose type was approved before 1 November 2019 (CIBS art. L. 421-15). Legacy aliases accepted: art_1008_II, art_1008_III_1998_2020

co2_g_km.description: CO2 g/km (NEDC), required only for the cibs_l421_15_1998_2020 regime

tools.name: calculate_overtime_fr
tools.description: Compute French overtime pay (heures supplémentaires) per labor code. Use for HR or employee verification. Inputs: hourly rate, normal hours, overtime hours. Returns gross overtime pay with 25%/50% premiums.

tools.name: get_smic_france
tools.description: French minimum wage (SMIC) in force since 1 June 2026, metropolitan France and Mayotte: hourly, monthly (35 h/week, 151.67 h) and annual amounts, gross and net, plus the previous rate (1 Jan-31 May 2026). Optional: hours per week to prorate the monthly amount. Use when someone asks the current SMIC, a percentage of the SMIC, or a part-time SMIC.

hours_per_week.description: Weekly hours for a prorated monthly SMIC (default 35)

territory.description: metropole (default, includes other overseas departments) or mayotte

tools.name: calculate_canada_sales_tax
tools.description: Canadian sales taxes by province or territory (rates in force since 1 April 2025): GST (TPS) + QST (TVQ) in Quebec, GST only in Alberta and the territories, or the single HST (TVH) in Ontario and the Atlantic provinces. British Columbia, Manitoba and Saskatchewan are not covered. Computes tax and total from a pre-tax amount, or the pre-tax amount from a tax-included total (mode "reverse").

province.description: Province or territory code (QC = Quebec, ON = Ontario...)

amount.description: Amount in CAD: pre-tax (mode "add") or tax-included (mode "reverse")

mode.description: add (default): pre-tax → total; reverse: total → pre-tax
